cases.prompt: Generic replicated chromosome with two sister chromatids and a centromeric region; no gene loci. Use warm gold, transparent native SVG, and named editable parts.
assertions: Native paths, no embedded bitmap
Transparent rendered edges
Named editable parts
Palette recolor preserves geometry
cases.human_notes: Agent visually inspected the gallery; not independent human review. Adapted from the user's approved native gold illustration.

cases.prompt: Generic mitochondrion with double membrane and cristae; no species-specific or molecular mechanism claim. Use warm gold, transparent native SVG, and named editable parts.
assertions: Native paths, no embedded bitmap
Transparent rendered edges
Inner membrane inside outer membrane (visual review)
Palette recolor preserves geometry
cases.human_notes: Generic simplified schematic, not to scale or species-specific. Agent visual inspection only.

cases.prompt: Generic unbranded single-channel pipette and one illustrative droplet; no quantitative volume markings. Use warm gold, transparent native SVG, and named editable parts.
assertions: Plunger, body, shaft, tip, droplet are grouped
Native paths and transparent edges
Palette recolor preserves geometry
cases.human_notes: Unbranded generic instrument; no volume, precision or real model claim. Agent visual inspection only.

cases.prompt: Show an authored proposed paired-assay idea, with a sample and control feeding an assay, then comparison and a readout. Native editable labels and dataflow connections; no measured results or invented papers.
assertions: Source access and support statuses are honest
All planned nodes, labels, endpoints and relation types have native SVG bindings
True transparent PNG with clear canvas edges
Recolor preserves native labels and topology
cases.human_notes: Authored proposed teaching idea only; agent visual review, not a source-grounded paper-method benchmark.

cases.prompt: Create a bounded native dependency schematic from inspected DESeq2 2014 passages. Keep raw counts, size factors, design and dispersions as distinct model inputs; show coefficient testing, no computed results. Check local source excerpts.
assertions: Local source hash and every locator/excerpt match
Raw counts remain a direct model input
Explicit plan regenerates the same native SVG
Actual alpha PNG and geometry-preserving recolor
Distinct target ports for separate model inputs
cases.human_notes: Agent source and visual review of selected primary-paper passages; not independent scientific review or a current software tutorial.

behaviors: Reject external resources and XML stylesheets
Fail unknown palette role before write

Reject declared content-budget and print-size violations
Reject incomplete layouts, node-crossing rails and unsupported direct skips
